# Juris Education
> Juris Education is an admissions consulting firm specializing in guiding applicants through every stage of the law-school admissions process. They focus exclusively on JD, LLM, transfer, and pre-law advising, offering personalized one-on-one services and application strategy, essay coaching, LSAT/GRE/Bar & MPRE prep delivered by a team of former admissions officers and legal professionals committed to maximizing each candidate's success. Beyond private counseling, the site offers expert-authored blogs, comprehensive downloadable guides, free tools (e.g., CAS GPA and LSAT calculators), and live webinars to demystify the application and test preparation process. Testimonials and case studies showcase real admits and score improvements, reinforcing Juris Education's proven track record in helping students gain entry and scholarships at top law programs
